title: avenula pubescens subsp. longifolia
intro: Avenula pubescens subsp. longifolia, commonly known as long-leaved oat-grass, is a type of grass species in the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its rich profile of bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The health benefits of Avenula pubescens subsp. longifolia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in the plant, including sesquiterpenes like β-eudesmol and β-selinene, contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
